map.E、I 单位怎么统一？: How do I unify the units of E and I?
map.→ 打开梁挠度计算工具: -> Open the beam deflection calculator tool
map.屋面/吊顶 [L/200]~[L/250]，楼面 [L/300]~[L/400]: Roofs and suspended ceilings [L/200] to [L/250], floors [L/300] to [L/400], crane beams [L/600] to [L/750].
map.悬臂雨棚端部堆载，按悬臂工况算自由端挠度。: Stacked load at the tip of a cantilever canopy, computing the free-end deflection under the cantilever condition.
map.简支梁均布挠度: Simply supported beam uniform load deflection
map.简支梁均布荷载吊顶，校核跨中挠度 [L/250]。: A simply supported beam with uniform load hanging from it, checking midspan deflection against [L/250].
map.简支梁挠度计算器。选择荷载工况，输入跨度、截面惯性矩、弹性模量与荷载，求最大挠度: Simply supported beam deflection calculator. Choose a load case, enter the span, second moment of area, elastic modulus and load to get the maximum deflection and compare it with the allowable value to judge whether the stiffness requirement is met, for beam member design.
map.统一用 N、mm：E(GPa)×1000=N/mm²，I(cm⁴)×10⁴=mm: Use N and mm throughout: E(GPa) x 1000 = N/mm2, I(cm4) x 10^4 = mm4, and delta comes out in mm.
map.许用挠度怎么取？: How is the allowable deflection taken?
map.设备基础梁按动载工况留安全余量。: Leave a safety margin on equipment foundation beams for dynamic load cases.
map.：简支梁 L=5 m、q=10 kN/m、E=200 GPa、I=500 cm⁴: : a simply supported beam with L = 5 m, q = 10 kN/m, E = 200 GPa and I = 500 cm4 = 5 x 10^6 mm4 gives delta = 5qL^4/(384EI) = 16.3 mm; the allowable L/250 = 20 mm is satisfied.
